args.code: (()=>{const text=document.body.innerText;const matches=[...text.matchAll(/([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,4})\s+(?:村长|老农|张婶|二蛋|老板|医生|渔夫|教师|村民)\s*\n\s*(亲密|挚友|友好)\s*\((\d+)\/(\d+)\)/g)];const allMatches=[...text.matchAll(/([\u4e00-\u9fa5]+)\s*\n\s*(?:亲密|挚友|友好)\s*\((\d+)\/(\d+)\)/g)];return JSON.stringify({matches:matches.map(m=>({name:m[1],relation:m[2],value:m[3]})),allMatches:allMatches.map(m=>({name:m[1],value:m[2]}))});})()
